what: When one shared script of the app breaks, every browser test fails and the browser-test check is now stopped at its new 8-minute limit before it names a single failing test: its output says only "checks.py: stopped after 8 minutes", with no list of red tests and no red-alone or flaky verdicts. I ran this on a throwaway copy of the branch with one line of webapp/static/api.js broken: the check took 8.0 minutes and its output named no test. Under the old 20-minute limit the same run finished and listed them. The cause is that the browser-test runner prints its failures and writes its result section only after the whole four-worker run ends, and a run where every test waits out its 5-second timeout needs more than 8 minutes, so the limit kills it first; the runner's own note on its re-run cap says it exists so that a mass failure still names every test inside the limit, and the new limit breaks that promise. Later tickets build on this result: ticket 05's flaky-test file and ticket 07's quick run are written by the same runner, so fixing it now is one change, later it is one per ticket.
where: checks.py:36 (walks limit 8) with walks/run_walks.py:47 (ALONE_CAP note) and walks/run_walks.py:73 (failures printed only after the run)
